about_the_game:
A Subterranean Anomaly Horror Experience

Trapped deep beneath the earth in an underground complex, you awaken to the echoing beep of a countdown. Explosives have been armed. The lights flicker. The walls breathe. You don’t know how you got here—but you do know one thing: when the music stops, so do you.

Navigate a looping, ever-changing labyrinth where nothing stays the same for long. Shadows twist wrong. Objects duplicate. Faces lie. You're being watched, but you’re not sure by what—or how many.

Every corridor may conceal an anomaly: some subtle, some grotesque. Identify them. Memorize patterns. Trust your instincts, not your eyes. The music is your timer, and once it ends... so does your chance to escape.

Can you spot what shouldn't be there before it's too late?







Differences between demo and full game

*Vertical slice of the full experience

*Limited selection of anomalies and entities

* Limited objectives

* Single ending

short_description: Reality shifts. Time loops. You're trapped underground with only 15 minutes and something’s changing the rules. Spot the anomalies. Find the way out before the map turns against you or you might just run out of time. What you see may not be real.
